_comment: AAP 2.7 does NOT support importing survey JSON files. This file is provided as a REFERENCE ONLY for manual survey creation through the AAP GUI. See AAP_COMPLETE_GUIDE.md for step-by-step instructions.
_usage: This JSON shows the survey structure but must be manually recreated in AAP GUI: Resources → Templates → [Template Name] → Survey → Add
name: RHEL Security Benchmark Configuration Survey
description: Configure security benchmark (STIG/CIS) audit and remediation options

spec.question_description: Select which security benchmark to apply: DISA STIG, CIS Server L1/L2, CIS Workstation L1/L2, or general CIS
spec.choices:
stig
cis_server_l1
cis_server_l2
cis_workstation_l1
cis_workstation_l2
cis
spec._manual_setup_note: In AAP GUI: Answer type = 'Multiple Choice (single select)', Options = 'stig', 'cis_server_l1', 'cis_server_l2', 'cis_workstation_l1', 'cis_workstation_l2', 'cis' on separate lines

spec.question_description: Select whether to audit ALL rules or only specific rules from the selected benchmark
spec._manual_setup_note: In AAP GUI: Answer type = 'Multiple Choice (single select)', Options = 'full' and 'selective' on separate lines

spec.question_name: Security Rules to Audit (comma-separated, for selective mode)
spec.question_description: List specific security rules to audit from the selected benchmark. Only used when Audit Mode is 'selective'. Example: sysctl_crypto_fips_enabled,audit_rules_login_events,sshd_set_idle_timeout
Apply fixes to failed security rules? If false, performs audit only.
spec._manual_setup_note: In AAP GUI: Answer type = 'Multiple Choice (single select)', Options = 'true' and 'false' on separate lines

spec.question_description: Automatically restore from backup if system verification fails after remediation?
spec._manual_setup_note: In AAP GUI: Answer type = 'Multiple Choice (single select)', Options = 'true' and 'false' on separate lines

spec.question_description: Organization-specific tailoring profile name. Leave blank for benchmark defaults. Example: myorg
